review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: About the Role We are looking for a Middle Business Analyst with hands-on Quality Assurance experience to join our team. In this role, you will act as a bridge between business stakeholders, product, development, and QA teams , translating business needs into clear and actionable requirements while helping ensure that delivered solutions meet both functional expectations and quality standards. Key Responsibilities Gather, analyse, validate, and document business and functional requirements. Translate business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, process flows, and functional specifications . Identify requirements gaps, dependencies, risks, and areas requiring further clarification. Review completed functionality against business requirements and acceptance criteria. Maintain accurate and up-to-date project, requirements, and product documentation. Requirements
